abiku: An abiku, the spirit of a child, a small translucent figure of a young child with sorrowful ancient eyes far too old for the face, pale blue-white and semi-transparent, fine ritual marks on the cheeks, standing barefoot
adze: An adze, a monstrous firefly the size of a cat, a glowing abdomen pulsing sickly yellow-green, LONG NEEDLE PROBOSCIS, translucent veined wings blurred with motion, a disturbing half-human quality to its head, spindly black legs
agropelter: An agropelter, a wiry long-armed creature with a slender weasel-like body and an ape's shoulders, PERCHED IN A HOLLOW TREE TRUNK, one arm drawn back holding a heavy dead branch ready to throw, wild grinning face
akualele: An akualele, a flying ball of fire with a long trailing tail like a comet, the core white-hot and the edges orange and violet, a faint suggestion of a screaming face inside the flame, no body, pure burning light in flight
amarok: An amarok, an enormous lone wolf far larger than any real wolf, shaggy grey-white winter coat, MASSIVE SHOULDERS AND JAWS, pale ice-blue eyes, breath steaming, standing alone in a hunting stance
amikuk: An amikuk, a skinless creature with FOUR LONG MUSCULAR ARMS and no legs, glistening red-brown flesh, a smooth eyeless head, arms splayed as if swimming through solid ground, boneless and fluid
asanbosam: An asanbosam, a gaunt long-limbed creature with IRON HOOKS INSTEAD OF FEET, ashen skin stretched over a bony frame, very long dangling arms, a wide mouth of iron teeth, hanging upside down, isolated figure with nothing behind it
ashiaraiyashiki: An enormous filthy bare HUMAN FOOT AND ANKLE, hairy and caked with mud, the leg disappearing upward out of frame, toes spread, gigantic in scale, nothing else of the creature visible
babayagahut: A small wooden hut standing on TWO ENORMOUS SCALY CHICKEN LEGS with splayed clawed feet, dark weathered timber, one shuttered window like a squinting eye, a skull on the fence post, the legs bent as if mid-step
baize: A bai ze, a noble lion-bodied beast with a MAN'S BEARDED FACE, NINE EYES arranged over its head and flanks, and SIX HORNS, golden fur, an air of great learning and calm, seated upright
bannik: A bannik, a small wizened bathhouse spirit wreathed in STEAM, wet grey hair and beard plastered to his skin, reddened skin from the heat, LONG CLAWED FINGERS, seated on a wooden bench, a birch besom beside him
basajaun: A basajaun, a tall broad forest giant covered in LONG SHAGGY BROWN HAIR down to his feet, a great beard, a kindly weathered face, holding a shepherd's staff, standing alone, isolated figure with nothing behind it
berberoka: A berberoka, a swollen bloated river creature with a vastly DISTENDED BELLY FULL OF SWALLOWED WATER, mottled brown-green mud-caked skin, small eyes in a broad flat head, long thin arms, water dribbling from its mouth
betobetosan: Betobeto-san, a small rounded shadowy figure that is almost entirely a WIDE SMILING MOUTH and two small eyes, dark grey and featureless otherwise, no visible arms, standing on two little sandalled feet, oddly polite
blackshuck: Black Shuck, an enormous shaggy BLACK DOG the size of a calf standing alone in profile, matted black coat, EYES BURNING RED like coals, heavy paws, head lowered, isolated subject with nothing behind it
boggart: A boggart, a lumpy shaggy household spirit about the size of a dog, dark matted fur, a long sour face with a downturned mouth, spindly clever fingers, mismatched ears, a resentful sulking posture
boitata: A boitatá, a long serpent made entirely of FIRE, its coils burning blue-white at the core and orange at the edges, TWO ENORMOUS GLOWING EYES far too large for its head, no solid body, pure flame in a serpent's shape
bulgasari: A bulgasari, a bear-bodied beast with a RHINOCEROS HORN, an elephant's trunk, the eyes of a rhinoceros and the tail of an ox, its hide COVERED IN IRON PLATES AND NAILS IT HAS EATEN, chewing a metal bar
bultungin: A bultungin, a werehyena caught mid-transformation, powerful spotted hyena head and sloping shoulders on a standing human body, one hand still human and the other a heavy clawed paw, a blacksmith's leather apron and hammer
bungisngis: A bungisngis, a large cheerful giant with ONE EYE in the middle of its forehead and an ENORMOUS UPPER LIP folded back over the top of its own head, wide open mouth mid-laugh showing huge teeth, tan skin
camahueto: A camahueto, a young bull calf with a SINGLE CRYSTAL HORN on its forehead, damp earth and torn roots clinging to its flanks as if it has just pushed up out of the ground, dark hide, powerful shoulders
centaur: A centaur, the torso of a bearded muscular man joined at the waist to the body of a powerful horse, chestnut coat, carrying a bow, weathered tanned skin, drawn heroic and lean rather than bulky
chullachaqui: A chullachaqui, an ordinary-looking man in a simple smock standing alone, but with ONE FOOT A DEER HOOF AND THE OTHER TURNED COMPLETELY BACKWARDS, a too-fixed smile, isolated figure with nothing behind it
curupira: A curupira, a small boy-sized forest guardian with BRIGHT FLAME-RED HAIR, green-brown skin, and FEET TURNED COMPLETELY BACKWARDS with heels at the front, holding a length of vine, fierce protective expression
cwnannwn: A cŵn annwn, a spectral hunting hound with a GLOWING WHITE COAT and BRIGHT RED EARS, lean and long-legged like a greyhound, faintly luminous, mouth open in a bay, running through open air
dakuwaqa: Dakuwaqa, a Fijian shark god, the upper body of a heavily muscled tattooed warrior joined to the lower body and tail of a large grey shark, a SHARK HEAD AND JAWS forming his own head, scarred hide, powerful and battered
dokkaebi: A dokkaebi, a stocky goblin with a SINGLE HORN, bulging eyes, a wide grinning mouth of blunt teeth, mottled green-brown skin, wearing ragged hanbok, carrying a SPIKED WOODEN CLUB, mid-laugh, playful not evil
domovoi: A domovoi, a tiny old man the size of a cat with an ENORMOUS GREY BEARD covering most of his body, bright shrewd eyes, dressed in a scrap of red cloth, standing beside a clay stove, holding a crust of bread
douen: A douen, the spirit of a child with a FACELESS SMOOTH BLANK FACE under a WIDE STRAW HAT, small and barefoot with FEET TURNED BACKWARDS, wearing a simple smock, standing at the edge of the forest, calling
draugr: A draugr, a barrow-dweller, a SWOLLEN BLUE-BLACK CORPSE in rusted mail and helm, unnaturally broad and heavy, eyes glowing faintly, holding a notched sword, grave-dirt and mould on its shoulders
dullahan: A dullahan, a HEADLESS RIDER in black, holding his OWN SEVERED HEAD ALOFT in one hand, the head grinning ear to ear with darting eyes and mouldy pale skin, a whip of human spine in the other hand
eloko: An eloko, a small forest dwarf with GRASS GROWING INSTEAD OF HAIR, dark bark-textured skin, a mouth far too wide for its face full of pointed teeth, carrying a small carved BELL in one hand, piercing yellow eyes
fossegrim: A fossegrim, a lean young man seated on a wet rock beneath a waterfall, naked to the waist, LONG WET HAIR, playing a FIDDLE, water streaming around him, pale skin, an absorbed faraway expression
gashadokuro: A gashadokuro, a COLOSSAL HUMAN SKELETON, yellowed and cracked bone, looming and hunched forward with its enormous skull lowered, empty eye sockets, one huge bony hand reaching down, drawn to look fifteen times human height
ghul: A ghūl, a gaunt desert shapeshifter with ashen cracked skin, LONG THIN LIMBS and clawed hands, the head part hyena and part human with a mouth of long teeth, tattered burial cloth, hunched over in a graveyard posture
golem: A golem, a massive humanoid figure crudely shaped from GREY RIVER CLAY, thick featureless limbs, rough thumbprints and tool marks in the surface, blank face with hollow eyes, HEBREW LETTERS INSCRIBED ON ITS FOREHEAD
gorgon: A gorgon, a woman whose hair is a MASS OF WRITHING LIVE SNAKES, a broad staring face with wide unblinking eyes and bared teeth, bronze-green skin, drawn in the style of an archaic Greek gorgoneion mask, confronting the viewer
gumiho: A gumiho, a fox with NINE FLOWING TAILS fanned behind it, russet and cream fur, drawn part-transformed with the elegant face of a woman emerging from the fox's features, Korean hanbok silk around the shoulders
hidebehind: A hidebehind, a tall thin forest creature drawn PARTLY CONCEALED BEHIND A TREE TRUNK with only one long clawed arm, one thin leg and half a narrow snarling face visible, dark bark-coloured hide, impossibly slender
huakaipo: A night marcher, a tall Hawaiian warrior ghost in a feathered cloak and crested feather helmet, carrying a burning torch and a spear, the figure semi-transparent and lit from below by the torch, stern and unseeing
huldra: A huldra, shown from a three-quarter rear angle: a beautiful woman in a woollen dress from the front, but with a LONG COW'S TAIL and a BACK THAT IS HOLLOW LIKE A ROTTED TREE TRUNK, bark-textured inside, glancing back
huma: A huma bird in flight, a magnificent long-winged bird with flowing plumage in gold, green and deep blue, an elegant crested head, LONG TRAILING TAIL FEATHERS, wings fully spread, drawn as never having landed, no feet visible
ifrit: An ifrit, a towering jinn of SMOKELESS FIRE, the body formed of dark smoke and molten orange cracks like cooling lava, curved horns, glowing white eyes, arms crossed, the lower body trailing away into smoke
ijiraq: An ijiraq, a shifting Arctic figure that is never fully seen, part caribou and part human, its FACE BLURRED AND UNFIXED as if seen from the corner of the eye, antlers, long limbs, edges dissolving into snow-glare
ilomba: An ilomba, a thick water snake with a HUMAN FACE set into the front of its head, the face calm and recognisably a person, olive-brown scales with a pale belly, coiled in shallow water, deeply unsettling
jengu: A jengu, a water spirit with dark skin and VERY LONG WAVY BLACK HAIR flowing around her, a warm smile showing a PROMINENT GAP BETWEEN THE FRONT TEETH, a fish tail below the waist in blue and silver, cowrie shells in her hair
jerseydevil: The Jersey Devil, a lean bipedal creature with the HEAD OF A HORSE, LEATHERY BAT WINGS, cloven hooves, a long forked tail and short clawed forearms, dark grey hide, rearing with wings half spread, screaming
jiangshi: A jiangshi, a stiff upright corpse in QING DYNASTY OFFICIAL ROBES AND CAP, arms held rigidly straight out in front, greenish-white mottled skin, long claws, a YELLOW PAPER TALISMAN HANGING OVER ITS FACE, hopping
jorogumo: A jorōgumo, a woman from the waist up and a GOLDEN ORB-WEAVER SPIDER below, with long black-and-yellow banded spider legs, silk trailing from her hands, a patterned kimono over the human half, eight small eyes on her brow
kamapuaa: Kamapua'a, a huge black boar with bristled shoulders and upcurved tusks, EIGHT EYES arranged in rows across its broad face and EIGHT STOUT LEGS, tufts of fern and grass caught in its coarse coat, steam at the nostrils
